description: Splits a coding task into independent parallel agent workstreams with disjoint write sets, explicit inputs and outputs, dependency ordering, and a merge/review plan. Use when several subtasks can proceed without shared mutable state. Not for tightly coupled edits, one failing root cause, or parallel changes to the same files.
